## Fourth Global Coral Bleaching Event Set a Record for Heat-Stress Exposure

The fourth global coral bleaching event was confirmed on April 15, 2024. Separately, satellite data show bleaching-level heat stress across roughly 84.4% of global reef area over the period from January 2023 through September 2025.

That measured footprint exceeded the 68.2% recorded during the 2014–2017 event. Mass bleaching was documented in at least 83 countries and territories. The record concerns the area exposed to bleaching-level heat stress; it does not mean that every exposed reef was verified as bleached or dead.
